requirement: Show red/yellow/green extension health beside the Extension button and remove the remaining Word 500 ads.

architecture.decision: Include the installed manifest version in the existing readiness event and compare it to one app-side current-version constant; extend the existing tab-scoped ad blocker with Word 500's verified Raptive/video ad domains and cosmetic markers.
seams: Red means no readiness response, yellow means readiness without the exact current version, and green means the exact current extension version.
Older extensions that send no version must remain compatible and display yellow rather than green.
Word 500 blocking remains limited to Puzzle Date-enabled tabs and must not alter gameplay, progress, or ordinary browsing.

tasks.title: Add extension health indicator
tasks.intent: Expose installed extension version through readiness and render accessible red/yellow/green health beside the Extension button.
tasks.constraints: Use one expected-version constant; treat missing version as outdated; preserve the current readiness timeout and popup behavior; provide accessible status text and non-color cues.
tasks.acceptance: Missing extension is red, an older/no-version extension is yellow, and exact version 1.0.9 is green; the status is visible beside the Extension control on desktop and mobile and announced accessibly.
tasks.verify: npm run build:pages && npm run validate:extension && node --check chrome-extension/content.js && git diff --check
tasks.visual: Use Chrome to verify red without the extension response, yellow with 1.0.8, and green after 1.0.9 reload.
tasks.result: Readiness now reports the installed manifest version; the app safely maps no response to red, an older/unknown version to yellow, and exact 1.0.9 to green with tooltip, aria-label, and live accessible text. Build, validator, syntax, and whitespace checks pass.

tasks.title: Block Word 500 ads and release 1.0.9
tasks.intent: Block the verified Word 500 ad sources and containers, package and publish the next extension.
tasks.constraints: Add only verified Raptive/npttech/videoplayerhub roots and narrow Raptive cosmetic selectors; retain all prior blocker/consent/reset behavior; sync only verified files.
tasks.acceptance: Word 500 has no loaded or visible Raptive/video ads inside Puzzle Date, gameplay and Start Over still work, version 1.0.9 is packaged, and the live in-app download matches the Chrome-tested ZIP.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:pages && unzip -t public/downloads/puzzle-date-game-reset.zip
tasks.visual: Reload 1.0.9 in Chrome, verify Word 500 ad-free plus health dot green, then regress Connections/Waffle and Start Over.
tasks.result: Extension 1.0.9 blocks Word 500's verified AdThrive, npttech, and videoplayerhub roots plus narrow injected AdThrive/video containers. Google Tag Manager was deliberately excluded during review to avoid unnecessary breakage. Release copy and ZIP were updated; validator, packaging, Pages build, ZIP integrity, JS syntax, and diff checks pass.
